name: Employment Residence Permit (third-country national employee)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a confirmed job offer from a Cyprus-registered employer, who must apply jointly for the work and residence permit.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a confirmed job offer from a Cyprus employer.

requirements.blocker_text: The Department of Labour must confirm no suitable EU/Cypriot candidate is available for the role, unless the position falls under an exempted category (e.g. Business Facilitation Unit companies, certain highly-skilled roles).

evidence_required.document: Labour market test result or applicable exemption
Health insurance, clean criminal record, medical certificate

sources.title: GK Law Firm -- Cyprus work permit for non-EU staff: the employer's guide
